patthana8.37:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca na cittasampayutto dhammo uppajjati, hetupaccayā. cittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ ca rūpaṃ-. na cittasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na cittavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. cittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasampayuttakā khandhā-.
patthana8.37:2.1: (paccanīyadukamattāni na vattabbāti. dhammaṃ pūretuṃ nava pañhāni karotu.)
